Loan interest subsidy filing guide

Qualified technology SMEs may apply for a loan interest subsidy filing. The process includes online filing, document verification, and subsidy disbursement.

Required materials include a business license, loan contract, and interest payment evidence. This paragraph is the main content that extraction should keep.
